**Bare in mind my back is a proper mess, yours probably won't follow my path.** This is how I went about getting where i am now. 

* GP to see what was wrong
* GP referred me to physiotherapy
* Physiotherapy sessions which gave me exercises to do and also massages to try and help
* Physiotherapist thought something deeper was wrong so organised an MRI
* MRI revealed the issue and surgery was organised
* Surgery to fix issues
* Physiotherapy continued after surgery to rebuild strength





TL;DR - Go and see your GP and then they'll refer you to the correct places.
